settings.prompt: Edit the supplied Everlane photo into a pose guidance image. Preserve the original full body image, outfit, image frame and asymmetric standing action exactly. Add thin colored anatomical skeleton dots and lines over the head center, neck base, shoulders, elbows, wrists, hips, knees, ankles. The image-right forearm enters a trouser pocket: mark that wrist/hand as uncertain using a dashed line and hollow dot, do not invent a visible hand. Keep shirt long sleeves (image-right rolled to forearm), white inner top and black wide trousers. This is an illustrative pose guide, not detector truth. No text labels, no collage.

native_tool_output_hint: Generated images are saved to /workspace/generated_images as /workspace/generated_images/exec-b007bd09-7d3d-4aa0-a7ac-de9e5c21943a.png by default.
